hypothesis.statement: For identical deterministic Python hot-path workloads and a fixed coding-agent configuration, either Rust migration tool can improve whole-application runtime while preserving externally observed behavior; the tools may differ in correctness coverage, integration burden, time-to-verified-port, and realized speedup.
hypothesis.null: Neither tool improves the primary quality-constrained outcome over the unmodified Python baseline.
hypothesis.threshold: A treatment is eligible for a win only when every independent held-out correctness case passes and the median whole-application runtime improves over baseline by at least 5%; report confidence intervals and all secondary outcomes.

assignment.unit: randomized treatment order within each task_id × replicate block

design.replication: 6 frozen tasks × 3 treatments × 3 independent repetitions = 54 planned observations; task replication and repeated executions remain separately identified.
design.unit_of_observation: one executed task under one treatment and repetition = one EXPERIMENT record
design.stopping: Complete the pre-registered 54-run cohort. Stop an individual cell on a correctness-gate failure; retain the failed record and classify the remaining dependent execution as blocked. Any cohort change creates a new design version.

tasks.contract: deterministic Unicode-aware string normalization and matching
deterministic deduplication and ranking over fixed records
deterministic nested JSON transformation with exact serialization contract
deterministic token and pattern scan over fixed text corpus
deterministic traversal and aggregation over a fixed graph
deterministic numeric aggregation with declared float comparison policy

execution_environment.os: one pinned Linux runner image; exact image digest recorded before execution
execution_environment.hardware: same runner class and resource limits for all arms
execution_environment.agent: one fixed provider/model@version, system prompt hash, tool manifest hash, role and instance_key across all arms; exact identity recorded before dispatch
execution_environment.workload: same committed fixture corpus, inputs, expected outputs, and held-out cases across all arms
execution_environment.cache: cold and warm states measured separately; primary comparison uses predeclared warm-state protocol with interleaved arm order

primary: independent held-out behavioral parity pass rate
median whole-application wall-clock speedup versus native baseline
secondary: token or credit usage when measured
outcomes.quality_gate: 100% pass on the same independent held-out correctness suite, including return values, error behavior, stdout/stderr, exit code, and declared side effects.
outcomes.analysis: Report per-task paired differences, medians, dispersion and confidence intervals; distinguish task replication from repeated runs; retain failures and missing measurements; do not collapse quality, speed, cost, security and maintenance into an opaque scalar.

comparability.common_primary_scope: Both candidates' `go` hot-path workflow against the same Python 3.13 fixtures.
comparability.fast_anything_scope: Selective hot-function port; reversible enable/disable; recorded-call replay and derived edge cases.
comparability.rust_anything_scope: Selective `go` hot-path port only for the primary cohort. Whole-app piecewise migration, side-effect replay and `app lift` form a separate secondary capability study.
comparability.exclusions: Do not rank whole-app rust-anything capabilities against fast-anything hot-path-only behavior. Do not mix languages, agent configurations, runner images or fixture generations within a cohort.

automation.requirement: Campaign-specific GitHub Actions automation must dispatch the frozen cohort, randomize within blocks, emit one canonical EXPERIMENT.schema.json record per executed run, preserve append-only records, and generate SUMMARY.json.
automation.authority: Existing GitHub Actions, DoE family and proposal gates; no new scheduler, experiment ledger or merge authority.

admission_gates: Freeze and commit all six executable Python fixtures and the independent held-out correctness corpus.
Pin the Linux runner image digest and capture the exact Python/Rust toolchain versions.
Freeze one coding-agent configured instance and all prompt/tool hashes.
Validate the design against DOE-TAXONOMY.md and the canonical EXPERIMENT.schema.json.
Implement and test the campaign automation and append-only record emission.
Run the complete randomized blocked cohort; retain one schema-valid record per executed run.
Publish SUMMARY.json with per-task effects, uncertainty, missingness, cost and correctness-gate results.
promotion: Candidate remains not admitted until design, automation, fixtures, and run evidence satisfy the DoE family intake rule. Any promotion into a reusable repo template requires independent verification, license/provenance review, and a new version/cohort record.
